name: lumen
description: Foundational compiler for the Lumen systems language

scripts.bootstrap:self: ./build/lumen-compiler compiler/main.lm build/lumen-compiler-self.ll && clang -Wno-override-module build/lumen-compiler-self.ll src/runtime/http.c -pthread -o build/lumen-compiler-self
scripts.bootstrap:all: npm run bootstrap && npm run bootstrap:self
scripts.run:basic: npm run compile:basic && npm run link:basic && ./build/basic; test $? -eq 3
scripts.run:control: npm run compile:control && npm run link:control && ./build/control-flow; test $? -eq 23
scripts.run:self:basic: npm run compile:self:basic && npm run link:self:basic && ./build/basic-self; test $? -eq 3
scripts.run:self:control: npm run compile:self:control && npm run link:self:control && ./build/control-flow-self; test $? -eq 23
